title: Vercel production deploy alignment
userReport: User identified they were likely viewing a Vercel app, not Firebase Hosting, and suspected GitHub/Vercel auto deployment had not updated the mobile app.

diagnosis.localVercelConfigBefore: No vercel.json or .vercel config was present before this fix.
diagnosis.githubWorkflows: No .github/workflows directory exists locally or on GitHub main; there was no GitHub Actions deployment workflow to refresh Vercel.
diagnosis.vercelProjectsBefore: Vercel CLI reported no projects under aljjang95s-projects before scoped deploy.
diagnosis.conclusion: Firebase deploys were current, but an existing/expected Vercel mobile URL would not have received these local fixes until a Vercel deployment was run.

changes: Added vercel.json for static hosting rewrites and no-store headers for index.html and sw.js.
Added .vercelignore so Vercel uploads only deployable runtime assets and excludes .gjc/tmp/scripts/docs/js/rules artifacts.
Ran a scoped Vercel production deployment under aljjang95s-projects.
Vercel linked/created project aljjang95s-projects/vocal-studio and connected GitHub repository https://github.com/aljjang95/vocal-studio.
residualBlockers: G004/G005 live split-write and Storage upload receipts still require a logged-in admin browser to run 관리자 검증 → 라이브 G004/G005 검증 and provide/copy the JSON receipt.
Future Vercel Git integration deployments require these local repository changes to be committed and pushed; commit/push was not performed because explicit push approval was not given.
